# Astranex Defence

> Astranex Defence is an autonomous defence technology company developing intelligent robotic platforms and edge-AI security systems engineered for mission-critical land, air, and maritime operations.

## Core Information
- Official Website: https://astranexdefence.com/
- Careers & Open Roles: https://astranexdefence.com/careers.html

- Contact: astranexdefence@gmail.com

## Focus Areas & Capabilities
- Autonomous Ground Vehicles (UGVs) & Modular Mechatronic Platforms
- Real-Time Edge-AI Computer Vision & Secure Tactical Communications
- Mission-Critical Autonomy and Intelligent Security Solutions
